title: AI Pushes Bounded Prime Gaps Below 246 to 212 (AxiomProver) and 186 / 182 (GPT-6 Astra)
whyItMatters: Days after Julia Stadlmann broke Polymath8b’s 12-year record of 246 with 240, AxiomProver certified a sieve deduction to 212 while GPT-6 Astra pushed conditional Lean bounds to 186 and 182.
summary: In early September 2026—immediately after Julia Stadlmann’s August 31 breakthrough (arXiv:2608.31126) lowered Polymath8b’s 12-year bounded prime gaps record from 246 to 240—two competing AI-powered analytic number theory efforts drove the bound sharply lower. On September 3, Axiom Math’s team (Ken Ono, François Charton, Ashvin Swaminathan, Jesse Thorner, et al.) optimized Stadlmann’s sieve to H₁ ≤ 212 and used AxiomProver to generate a Lean 4 certificate of the deduction (github.com/AxiomMath/BGP212). Concurrently, OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra released a conditional Lean 4 development claiming H₁ ≤ 186 (github.com/openai/PrimeGaps186, Sept 2), followed two days later by UCLA number theorist Romyar Sharifi prompting GPT-6 Astra to reach H₁ ≤ 182 across 918 audited Lean modules (github.com/romyar1/prime-gaps-lean, Sept 4).
technicalHighlights: Axiom Math (9 authors + AxiomProver) pushed bounded prime gaps from Stadlmann’s 240 to 212 with a Lean 4 deduction certificate (BGP212).
OpenAI GPT-6 Astra (PrimeGaps186) and Romyar Sharifi + GPT-6 Astra (prime-gaps-lean) pushed conditional Lean sieve bounds further to 186 and 182.
All developments check the intricate sieve/analytic deduction in Lean 4 while explicitly displaying external analytic/numerical hypotheses.
caveats: None of the 212, 186, or 182 Lean repositories is an unconditional end-to-end proof from first principles: each retains stated analytic equidistribution theorems and numerical integral inequalities as explicit Lean axioms/hypotheses, and peer review is ongoing.

scoreRationale.foundational: Substantially sharpens the famous Zhang–Maynard–Polymath8b bounded prime gaps frontier (246 → 212 → 186 → 182) toward Twin Primes.
scoreRationale.ripple: Triggered intense community debate over AI-accelerated follow-ups to junior researchers’ breakthroughs and conditional Lean certificates.
scoreRationale.verification: Deduction steps are machine-checked in Lean 4, but all three bounds remain conditional on external analytic/numerical inputs and unrefereed.
scoreRationale.velocity: Multiple competing AI teams broke the 240 barrier within 72 hours of Stadlmann’s preprint appearing.
